setup.welcomeSubtitle: First time only. Customize the brand and legal notice visitors will see on your encrypted notes site.
setup.welcomeBrandDesc: Name, logo, and colors with live preview.
setup.welcomeLegalDesc: Hidden, built-in template, or custom text.
setup.welcomeZkDesc: Notes are encrypted in the browser; the server never reads the content.
setup.brandHint: Everyone will see the same look. You only need to complete this once.
setup.step2Intro: The notice appears before creating notes. Custom text is not translated automatically.
setup.successSubtitle: Your site now has branding and a legal notice. From now on you'll see the app with your identity.
setup.successTipCreateDesc: Content is encrypted in the browser before it is sent.
setup.successTipShareDesc: Each note has its URL with the key in the fragment — it never travels to the server.
setup.logoHint: Optional. PNG, JPG, WebP, or GIF.
setup.errorLogo: Could not use this image. Try a smaller or simpler file.
setup.disclaimerHiddenDesc: Visitors will not see a legal screen.
setup.disclaimerCustomHint: Provide the terms and conditions in both languages. Visitors will see the version that matches the selected app language.
setup.errorDisclaimerCustom: Enter both a title and body for a custom notice.
setup.errorSave: Could not save. Check that the API is reachable and try again.
setup.sideTitle: Make the first visit feel intentional
setup.sideBody: Set the app identity and define the legal text visitors must read before using the service. You can provide the custom terms in English and Spanish.
home.title: Secured Note
home.tagline: Share sensitive information securely with self-destructing encrypted notes
home.footer.detail: Notes are encrypted in your browser using AES-GCM (Advanced Encryption Standard - Galois/Counter Mode), a NIST-approved authenticated encryption algorithm. The encryption key never leaves your device.
home.setup.title: Finish the first-time setup
